main_body: Broad leaf canopy made of seven rounded clumps, on a single brown trunk with a flared root base
top_band: At x=29, light green (#4d8743) at rows 1-2, then mid greens down to row 10. Each clump repeats the pattern: a lighter upper crown, then a darker underside. There is no flat lid.
evidence: This is an organic tree, not a box-like object. Each canopy clump has a lit upper surface and a darker lower mass, separated by a dark 1-row outline (x=29 row 11, x=43 row 26). The canopy overlaps itself and hangs over the trunk, so it reads as a volume seen from above and in front. The trunk is a plain front-facing column with a flared base, which is normal for a tree. No receding side faces.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 15 distinct colours and a median of 8 per tile. The references have 427 and 567 colours and a median of about 108 per tile. The canopy has about 5 greens (#71a854, #4d8743, #366a37, #27502d, #1b3a23) and the trunk about 3 browns. These make clean, smooth clumps with a few highlight dots but no leaf-cluster detail, no foliage breaking the silhouette, and no branches or roots showing through. The trunk is a flat vertical brown column with little grain. The outline is a dark green-tinted tone (#0b1812), only 20% near-neutral, so it is not a pure black sticker line. It is still far thinner and flatter than the references, and the gap in colour count is too large to pass.
